title: MIxS: Minimum Information about any (x) Sequence
description: Metadata framework with core and environmental packages for genomic, metagenomic and marker-gene data; enables consistent capture of contextual information for integration and reuse.
keyFeatures: Core and extension checklists; Environmental/context packages with controlled vocabularies; Supports FAIR data, interoperability and reuse
practicalUse: Adopt MIxS fields in LIMS and submission templates to standardize metadata for surveillance sequencing projects.
